name: Ookurayama Erika
source:
She is a third-year student at the school. She is the daughter of one of the best families in the school. She is calm and easily influenced.

She has a fiancé, whom she plans to marry after graduation. She has had sex with him and is not a virgin. However, unbeknownst to her, she was sold to the Yuutenji family by her family and fiancé.

[From [url=http://www.masterup.net/hina-soft/moe_hina/haramase/index.html]official site[/url]]
